embed_builder.name: File name
embed_builder.cards_hint: Each card is its own independent block (own color, own text/images). All cards are sent as one Discord message.
embed_builder.cards_empty_hint: Add a card to start building the message.

preview.empty: Add a card to see a preview...

settings.title: ⚙️ Bot Settings
settings.description: Managing Bot Settings and AI Behavior

main_settings.title: Main Settings
main_settings.description1: The character that marks the beginning of the bot's text commands.
main_settings.description2: This bot only operates in one server. Auto-locked to the first server it joins; leave it as-is unless you're deliberately moving the bot to a different server (the bot will leave any other server it's invited to).

system.title: 🔑 API Keys & System Tokens
system.description: Management of access tokens and system API keys.
system.warning: Attention: Changing the Discord Bot Token triggers an automatic restart of the container to apply the new settings. The web panel may be temporarily unavailable for 5–10 seconds.
system.field1_description: Hover your mouse over the field to view the token.
system.field2_description: From your app's OAuth2 page in the Developer Portal. Setting this turns on dashboard login (the Client ID is detected automatically). The login page shows the redirect URI you'll need to register there.

ai.title: 🤖 AI Provider & Keys
ai.description: Configured once here and shared by every plugin that uses a model, so an API key is never pasted into more than one place.
ai.provider_hint: Only the selected provider's key is used. The others can stay empty.

plugins.title: 🧠 Plugins
plugins.description: Enable, configure and reload plugins. Reloading applies a plugin's new code without restarting the bot.
plugins.browse_hint: Plugins offered by the configured sources. Installing runs someone else's code inside the bot — only install what you trust.
plugins.sources_hint: Where plugins may be installed from. A new source starts untrusted; plugins from an untrusted source are refused sidecar containers.

music.description: Worker bot accounts and YouTube playback. Enable or disable the module itself on the Plugins tab.
